title: Report: GTA 6 Players Find Over 1,500 Enterable Buildings Across Leonida
description: Eurogamer reports a player count of 1,563 enterable buildings out of 5,588 in GTA 6, about 27.97 percent of Leonida’s structures. The figure comes from a Reddit post by user Aileos and is not an official Rockstar announcement.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Has 1,563 Enterable Buildings, Player Count Finds
socialHook: A GTA 6 player counted 1,563 enterable buildings across Leonida, nearly 28 percent of the game's 5,588 structures, according to Eurogamer.

sections.heading: Player-Reported Building Count
paragraphs: Eurogamer reports that a GTA 6 player, identified in a Reddit post by user Aileos, examined every building in the game and found that 1,563 of 5,588 structures in Leonida can be entered and explored. That equals 27.97 percent of all buildings on the map. The outlet says some enterable locations are expected, such as stores and banks, while others may surprise players. Eurogamer attributes the count to the Reddit post and does not present it as an official Rockstar Games announcement.

sections.heading: How It Compares to Earlier Leaks
paragraphs: Eurogamer connects the discovery to a 2025 leak claiming that over 700 buildings could be freely entered in GTA 6, a claim that drew skepticism before release. The report also quotes Reddit user Macklaviel, who cautioned that unproven leaks should not set expectations. The current figure of 1,563 enterable buildings substantially exceeds that earlier rumored number, though Eurogamer makes clear the number comes from player testing rather than Rockstar confirmation.
